_prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE rule pack. Numbers reflect publicly documented Colorado Enterprise Zone Investment Tax Credit parameters as of late 2025; verify all values (credit amount, enterprise zone designations, thresholds) against current Colorado Office of Economic Development and International Trade guidance and C.R.S. § 39-30-105 before any real client use.

credit.name: Colorado Enterprise Zone Job Credit
credit.summary: State income tax credit for net new employees in a designated Colorado Enterprise Zone; $500 per qualifying new employee. Denver metro has several EZ-designated census tracts.

thresholds._note: No statutory minimum job count for the basic credit; this stub uses 5 as a minimum to filter immaterial credits. Enterprise Zone designation is required.

benefit._note: $500 per qualifying new employee per year, for up to 3 years. Carryforward of 7 years for unused credit.

geographic_scope._note: Enterprise Zones include portions of Denver metro and many rural counties. Prototype treats Denver as the qualifying geography.

one_zero._doc_source: Approximation patched in via rules/_patch_one_zero.py; verify against state DOR before client use.
one_zero._note: CO Enterprise Zone: per-employee per-site eligibility within designated EZ boundary. entity_combination pending DISC-4 confirmation.
